picks.title: Are synthetic users (really) the future of UX research?
picks.excerpt: Human-centered design demands limited use of AI-generated personas, if at all; the piece weighs the UX research debate over synthetic users.
picks.rationale: Synthetic-user research is a live decision for research teams; first time this topic appears in the 30-day history.

picks.title: Before an AI agent acts, show me what it can change
picks.excerpt: A UX pattern argument: agent permission prompts should preview exactly what an AI agent action will change instead of a bare 'Allow this action'.
picks.rationale: Concrete, reusable pattern for agent permission prompts (diff-preview instead of bare Allow) that product designers can apply directly.

picks.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite on AI Gateway
picks.excerpt: xAI's Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite video-generation model is now callable through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key, unified billing and request traces.
picks.rationale: New release: a video-generation model now one API key away for design/prototyping teams already on Vercel.

picks.title: Boston Dynamics gives more insight into its redesigned humanoid hand
picks.excerpt: Atlas's new hand was designed for high-fidelity simulation to enable sim-to-real reinforcement learning, Boston Dynamics' Alberto Rodriguez explains.
picks.rationale: Industrial-design insight: hardware shaped to be simulatable so AI can learn on it, a design-for-RL principle new to the brief.

picks.title: 4 team rituals that drive AI adoption
picks.excerpt: Four ways teams at Figma, Mercari, Atlassian and Sephora are building habits that help designers and product teams get real value from AI.
picks.rationale: Concrete team rituals from Figma, Mercari, Atlassian and Sephora that design leads can adopt to make AI use stick; adds Figma as a fifth distinct outlet.
